title: cbuild_state
description: The answer of GET cbuild/v1/kits/<id>/state: the state of a build of a kit. Fields are added in minor versions and never renamed or removed within a major one, so a reader lets through a field it does not know.

bearings_included.description: From 1.0.0: whether the wheels picked come with their bearings (the `bearings_included` spec), so the kit's bearings slot counts as filled and its step is no step (D-246).

currency.description: From 1.0.0: how the shop writes a price, from WooCommerce's settings and their filters, for a page that formats a total itself. `format` puts the symbol (`%1$s`) beside the amount (`%2$s`), as `get_woocommerce_price_format()` does.

code.description: The currency's ISO 4217 code: the shop's, or a currency switcher's.

decimals.description: How many decimals a price shows.

decimal_separator.description: Between the whole amount and its decimals.

format.description: Where the symbol goes: `%1$s%2$s`, `%2$s%1$s`, `%1$s %2$s` or `%2$s %1$s` as WooCommerce has it.

reopened.description: From 1.0.0, only on the answer to a build link that carries `_saved`, the UUID of the signed-in customer's own saved build of this kit, where it has changed since it was saved: what changed and the prices then and now (spec: A saved build that has changed; D-254, D-278). The answer's state is then the build with the closest parts in place, at the review.

changes.description: Each part gone, sold out or no longer fitting, in step order, with the closest part that fits in its place, or null where none does.

was.description: The part saved: a product's or a variation's ID.

name.description: Its name, or empty where it no longer reads.

closest.description: The closest part that fits in its place, or null.

prices.description: Each part kept whose price changed, in the same currency as when it was saved, with the price then and now as text.

then.description: The build's total when saved, as text, or null where no prices were kept in this currency (a build saved before 1.0.0).

now.description: The total now, with the closest parts in place, as text.

picks.description: The build with the closest parts in place: a part ID per slot.

first.description: The first slot that changed, which Choose myself opens, or `review`.

step.description: The step whose options are listed: the key of the slot asked for, or of the first with nothing picked; or `review`, for the step after the last slot's, which lists none.

ready.description: Whether the build may go to the cart.

texts.description: The kit's own texts, as the owner typed them or as a plugin answered the filter cbuild_kit_text.

lead_time.description: How long assembly takes, or an empty string.

returns_notice.description: What the shop says of returning an assembled build, or an empty string.

presets.description: The kit's ready builds, six at most.

description.description: A line on who it is for, or an empty string.

picks.description: A part for each slot it fills.

image.description: Its picture: for now its first slot's part's photo at the catalogue's size, or null when it has none. From 0.6.0.

total.description: What the build it starts costs, at the kit's own assembly setting. From 0.6.0.

ready.description: Whether the build it starts can go to the cart as it stands. From 0.6.0.

problems.description: What keeps it from the cart, such as a sold-out part, each part named. From 0.6.0.

steps.description: The kit's slots, in step order.

help.description: The slot's help text, or an empty string.

required.description: Whether a build needs a part here.

units.description: How many units of the part a build takes.

picked.description: The ID of the part picked, or null.

recommended.description: The ID of the part the step recommends while nothing is picked, or null. From 0.8.0 the total does not count it, and the estimate does.

offered.description: How many parts the slot offers.

hidden.description: How many parts the slot hides because they do not fit.

groups.description: The hidden parts, counted by reason.

message.description: The count and the reason as a sentence.

against.description: The picks before the step that its parts were checked against, by slot key, or null where no rule the kit has on reads the slot.

options.description: The parts the current step offers: the first 24, those the shop can supply first, and the part the step counts.

hidden.description: The parts the current step hides, each with why: the first 24, and the pick when it is one of them.

filters.description: What the current step's options can be filtered by. A list is empty where the parts offered have fewer than two values.

matching.description: How many of the parts the current step offers the filters let through.

more.description: How many options to ask for to list the next 24, or null when every one that matches is listed.

refused.description: The picks sent that were not taken.

problems.description: What keeps the build from the cart. Empty when ready is true.

changes.description: What the last change does to the picks after it, when previous was sent and a later pick no longer fits; otherwise null.

kept.description: The keys of the slots whose picks stay.

proposed.description: The build if the shopper takes the changes: a pick per slot, in step order. A slot with no part that fits has none.

changes.description: The picks that no longer fit, in step order.

was.description: The ID of the part picked.

name.description: Its name, or an empty string when the product has gone.

closest.description: The closest part that fits and is in stock, or null when there is none.

total.description: What the build costs so far.

lines.description: A line per part the build counts, in step order.

name.description: The part's name, or an empty string when the product has gone.

quantity.description: How many of the part the build takes.

price.description: The part's own price for one.

charged.description: What one is charged at, with the build discount off.

saved.description: What the build discount takes off.

assembly.description: Whether the shop assembles the build.

fee.description: The assembly fee: nothing when assembly is off or free.

estimate.description: What the board would cost with each slot's recommendation in it, priced as the total is, while a recommendation fills a slot and every slot the kit requires has a part; otherwise null. From 0.8.0.

picture.description: What is in the box: each part the total counts, in step order. From 0.7.0, the board as well: the layers of the parts with a layer image, placed in the layout's units, ten-thousandths of a millimetre, with the nose at the top.

label.description: The slot's label, with the part's brand and size where it has them: `Wheels: Retna, 54 mm`.

size.description: The part's size as a person reads it, such as `8.5 in`, or an empty string for a slot that has none.

name.description: The part's name, or an empty string when the product has gone.

image.description: The part's photo, else from 1.0.0 its layer image, uncropped; null when it has neither.

photo.description: Whether `image` is the part's photo, not its layer image (1.0.0).

drawn.description: Whether the board draws the part, which then has no labelled photo (0.7.0).

description.description: The build in one sentence, for whoever cannot see the picture.

width.description: The board across, wheels included, or 0 until a deck with a width is picked.

height.description: The board along, or 0 until a deck with a width is picked.

layers.description: The board seen from underneath, its layers from the bottom of the stack: the deck, one for each truck and one for each wheel, each a part with a layer image. Until 0.8.0 the grip was here too, as a 1 in strip; from 0.8.0 it is on the top.

top.description: From 0.8.0: the board seen from the top (#46), in the same units and places as `layers`, from the bottom of the stack: the four wheels, which the deck covers but where they stand out past its edges; the deck, whose layer image is the top's outline; the grip over the deck's whole box, its layer image the swatch that fills that outline nose to tail; and a bolt head at each of the deck's eight holes, the hardware's layer image. The trucks are not on it. Each is a part with a layer image, and the list is empty where the deck has none. The composed pictures are the underside alone.

delivery.description: What the shop says of the build's delivery, each in plain text and empty where nothing is said.

line.description: What its shipping costs, or how far it is from free shipping.

notes.description: Lines other plugins put under the total, in plain text: six at most.

shelf.description: From 1.0.0: the current step as the configurator lists it, one card per look (D-240 to D-264), or null on the review, which lists no parts. `options` and `filters` stay as they were, for whoever reads them.

view.description: Only in an answer to a build link (the cbuild argument): what the builder's template draws for it, as the page's first render has it. The builder's own, and no part of the public API: it may change in any release. The fields the store's script reads are described, so its types are generated from here; the rest are the templates'.

url.description: The view's own address, which the store puts in the page's.

title.description: The step's heading, which the store puts in the page's title.

status.description: What the status region says of the view.

isChanges.description: Whether the change panel is shown.

shown.description: Whether the error summary is shown.

slot.description: The step's slot, or empty at the review.

added.description: What the status says after Show more: how many it added, or empty (1.0.0).

copied.description: What the status says once the link is copied.

added.description: What the builder says once the build is in the cart.

turnable.description: Whether the board has a top to show: its deck has a layer image (0.8.0).

turned.description: Whether the board shows its top: on the grip step, as the server renders it; the store keeps the side the shopper turned it to (0.8.0).

layer.description: One layer of the board: a part with a layer image, where it is drawn and the image.

x.description: The layer's left edge from the board's.

y.description: The layer's top edge from the board's, the nose's end.

image.description: The part's layer image: its own file, and the renditions made of it.

sources.description: The renditions made, a `srcset` for each type, AVIF first; none until they are made.

srcset.description: Its files with their widths, smallest first.

money.description: An amount in the shop's currency.

amount.description: The amount in whole minor units: cents, where the currency has two decimals.

text.description: The amount as the shop writes its prices, in plain text.

code.description: The finding's code, one of the message codes in docs/HOOKS.md.

severity.description: How bad: a note on a part that fits, a warning, or a block.

text.description: The finding as a sentence, in the language of the answer.

short.description: From 1.0.0: the finding as a card's short label, where it has one, such as "Needs ⅛″ risers with your trucks"; otherwise empty.

card.description: What a card shows of a part.

name.description: The part's name, in plain text.

url.description: The address of the part's own page.

price.description: The price of one as the shop shows it, in plain text.

stock.description: The shop's own words for the part's availability, in the shop's stock display format. Empty where the shop says nothing of a part in stock.

stock_class.description: WooCommerce's class for the availability: in-stock, out-of-stock or available-on-backorder.

image.description: The part's photo at the catalogue's size, else from 1.0.0 its layer image, uncropped; null when it has neither.

photo.description: Whether `image` is the part's photo, not its layer image (1.0.0).

option.description: A part as a slot holds it.

id.description: The part's ID: a product's or a variation's.

brand.description: The slug of the part's brand, or an empty string.

size.description: The part's size, as its slot's parts are sized (a deck by its width, trucks by their axle, wheels by their diameter, risers by their thickness, bolts by their length), or null where the slot has no such size or the part does not give it.

value.description: The size as the size filter names it: `8.25in`, `54mm`.

text.description: The size as a person reads it.

delta.description: What taking the part does to the total, against the part the step counts now: what the build charges for as many as it takes.

kind.description: `more` or `less` than the part counted; `free`, for the same price; `included`, for the part counted itself; `none`, for a part that gives no set size and so has no price in a build.

amount.description: The change in the shop's minor units, below nothing where it comes off.

text.description: The change as its card says it: `+$12.00`, `−$5.00`, `Same price`, `Included`, or an empty string.

change.description: From 1.0.0: the change as it reads under the card's full price, once the step has a pick: `+$12.00 over your pick`, `$8.00 less`, `Same price`, `Included`, or an empty string (D-249).

fit.description: How the part fits the picks before it: the worst of its messages.

in_stock.description: Whether the shop has the part.

available.description: Whether the shop has as many as a build takes.

quantity.description: How many of the part a build takes, or null when the part gives no set size.

picked.description: Whether it is the step's pick.

recommended.description: Whether it is the part the step recommends. It is labelled, never picked.

messages.description: What the rules found of it, notes included.

card.description: What its card shows, or null when the product has gone since the index read it.

problem.description: A pick not taken, or something that keeps the build from the cart.

code.description: The problem's code, one of the problem codes in docs/HOOKS.md.

slot.description: The slot's key, as sent where the kit has no such slot.

part.description: The part's ID, or null where there is none to name.

message.description: The problem as a sentence, in the language of the answer.

messages.description: For a part the rules block, what they found.

photo.description: A photo at the catalogue's size.

value.description: The value as the filter names it.

label.description: The value as a person reads it.

count.description: How many of the parts the step offers have it.

selected.description: Whether the list is filtered by it.

shelf.description: A step's shelf: a page of the looks in stock, the sold-out fold, the chips, the deck's width question and the counts.

looks.description: The page of looks in stock, in the order asked: 30 at most from `from`.

sold_out.description: Every sold-out look the search and chips leave, in the same order, for the fold.

chips.description: The chip groups: brand, the size where the shopper picks it, and the attributes most of the step's looks carry; four at most, each with two values or more.

widths.description: On the deck step, each width the kit's decks come in, smallest first; empty on every other step.

offered.description: How many looks the step offers before any search or chip, which decides its tools: Sort and the chips from 13, search from 41.

matching.description: How many looks in stock the search and chips leave: the 90 of "Showing 30 of 90".

more.description: The `from` that asks for the next page, or null when none is left.

query.description: The search the step was listed with, as it was read: trimmed, 100 characters at most.

sort.description: The order the step was listed in.

elsewhere.description: From 1.0.0, on the deck step, where a search finds nothing in stock in the width asked: the widths its matches are in stock in, narrowest first, each with `value` and `text`; otherwise empty.

value.description: The width as the `width` argument names it: `8.5in`.

text.description: The width as a person reads it.

hidden_matching.description: From 1.0.0, where a search finds nothing to list here or in another width: how many of the step's parts that don't fit the build match it; otherwise 0.

look.description: A card: a product, or the variations of one that share a photo and a layer image.

key.description: What tells it from the step's other looks: its product, photo and layer image's IDs.

name.description: From 1.0.0: the product's name, in plain text: the parent's for a variation, so a look's card says "Katie", not "Katie - 8.25″" (D-273).

brand.description: From 1.0.0: the brand's name, in plain text, or an empty string.

look.description: From 1.0.0: the values that tell the look from its product's other looks in the step, such as ["Mint"]; empty where the product has one look (D-273).

part.description: The part the card shows and the build would take: the pick where it is in the look, else the size the build decides, else the size the shopper's chip or the recommendation wants.

sizes.description: The sizes it comes in on the slot's size, smallest first; empty where the slot has none.

items.description: A size, as the chips name it and as a person reads it.

value.description: The size as the chips and the `width` argument name it: `8.25in`, `54mm`.

text.description: The size as a person reads it, in the shop's units.

sized.description: From 1.0.0, on the look the step's pick is of and only where nothing in the build decides its size: each size it comes in, as the part of that size with the pick's other choices, smallest first, for the radio group after the picked card (D-279). Left out on any other look, and on a look in one size.

part.description: The part of this size: the step's pick when chosen.

value.description: The size as the chips name it: `54mm`.

text.description: The size as a person reads it.

in_stock.description: Whether the shop can supply it for the build.

picked.description: Whether it is the size the build holds.

choices.description: The choices you can't see: each attribute whose values differ between its parts, by attribute, with its values.

label.description: The value as the shop names it.

chipGroup.description: A group of chips: chips in one group widen, and groups narrow each other.

name.description: `brand`, the slot's size spec's key, or an attribute's taxonomy (`pa_…`), as the `chips` argument names it.

label.description: The group's name as a person reads it.

value.description: The value as the `chips` argument names it.

label.description: The value as a person reads it.

count.description: How many looks it leaves, with the other groups' chips applied and not its own.

width.description: A width the deck step's question offers.

value.description: The width as the `width` argument names it: `8.25in`.

text.description: The width as a person reads it.

in_stock.description: How many looks are in stock in it; a width with none shows dimmed.

selected.description: Whether it is the width asked.

presetProblem.description: What keeps a preset's build from the cart: a problem, with the name of the part it is about.

code.description: The problem's code, one of the problem codes in docs/HOOKS.md.

slot.description: The slot's key, as sent where the kit has no such slot.

part.description: The part's ID, or null where there is none to name.

message.description: The problem as a sentence, in the language of the answer.

messages.description: For a part the rules block, what they found.

name.description: The part's name, or an empty string.
